description: Escape hatch — run an arbitrary Python script inside the TouchDesigner process. Prefer the structured tools (find_td_nodes, get_td_node_parameters, update_td_node_parameters, summarize_td_errors, snapshot_td_graph, …); reach for this only when no structured tool can express the operation. Code runs in TD only, never on the local machine.

return_output.description: Capture stdout / the value of the last expression and return it.

script.description: Python source to execute inside TouchDesigner (runs in the TD process, not locally).

name: execute_python_script
title: Execute Python in TouchDesigner
